title: Leia’s Back
caption: Leia’s Back (V)
game_text: Use 1 Force to ▼ (or retrieve) Leia’s Blaster Rifle, Leia’s Sporting Blaster, or Leia. OR If you just initiated a Force drain where Leia is present, use 2 Force to make that Force drain +2.
